note: What a server sends to put a pet on the field. The header names the pet. Recorded only in what a server sent clients watching a match.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node it belongs to.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where it stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: spellLevel
fields.note: The level of the spell that summoned it, plus one.

fields.name: duration
fields.note: How long it lasts, in seconds.

fields.name: damageBonus
fields.note: What is added to the damage it deals.

fields.name: healthBonus
fields.note: What is added to its health.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Its name, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art under, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: effect
fields.note: An effect it carries, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: clone
fields.note: The unit it copies, or zero.

bits.name: copyInventory
bits.note: Set where it copies its owner's items.

bits.name: clearOwnerTarget
bits.note: Set where its owner's target is cleared.

bits.name: minimapIcon
bits.note: Set where it shows on the minimap.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: script
fields.note: The script that drives it, padded with zero bytes.

revisions.note: A client deletes any object holding the header's id; spawns nothing where it does not know the owner; kills the owner's earlier pet if it lives; makes the pet, replacing its script with script; gives it the owner's seat, its gold going to the owner; and registers it under the header's id and node. It does not read spellLevel, duration or effect.
